title: Blitch backs Randy Anderson's Crane story after Grusch introduction
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: uh I I I believe every aspect of his story

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked for the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says he believes "every aspect" of a story told by a man named Randy Anderson about Crane, a Navy weapons research site in Indiana. Blitch came to hear it after being introduced through David Grusch, a former intelligence officer. Blitch does not retell the story's details here, but his word matters because he is vouching for Anderson as someone he has heard firsthand.
